mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.account_id, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.amount, t.category_id FROM transactions t JOIN accounts a ON t.account_id = a.id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND t.account_id IS NOT NULL AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.card_id, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.amount, t.category_id FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.card_type = 'CHECK' AND t.card_id IS NOT NULL AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.card_id, t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.transaction_type, t.amount, t.category_id FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.card_type = 'CREDIT' AND t.card_id IS NOT NULL AND t.transaction_type = 'WITHDRAWAL' AND t.category_id IS NOT NULL AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND t.transaction_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ORDER BY t.transaction_date, t.transaction_time, t.id
SELECT id FROM spending_categories WHERE category_code = #{categoryCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT sp.monthly_amount FROM saving_plans sp JOIN trips t ON sp.trip_id = t.id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.status IN ('PLANNING', 'TRAVELING') AND t.is_deleted = 0 AND sp.goal_status = 'ACTIVE' AND sp.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, sp.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_spending_analyses SET total_spending = #{totalSpending}, saving_target_amount = #{savingTargetAmount}, actual_saving_amount = #{actualSavingAmount}, saving_difference_amount = #{savingDifferenceAmount}, saving_result_message = #{savingResultMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_category_analyses ( monthly_spending_analysis_id, category_id, spending_amount, spending_ratio, transaction_count, weekly_average, daily_average, previous_month_change, spending_rank, mission_period_spending, mission_transaction_count, spending_share_score, increase_score, amount_rank_score, recommendation_score, recommendation_rank, recommendation_eligible, exclusion_reason, recommendation_reason, coaching_message ) VALUES ( #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId}, #{categoryId}, #{spendingAmount}, #{spendingRatio}, #{transactionCount}, #{weeklyAverage}, #{dailyAverage}, #{previousMonthChange}, #{spendingRank}, #{missionPeriodSpending}, #{missionTransactionCount}, #{spendingShareScore}, #{increaseScore}, #{amountRankScore}, #{recommendationScore}, #{recommendationRank}, #{recommendationEligible}, #{exclusionReason}, #{recommendationReason}, #{coachingMessage} )
mapper.select: SELECT mca.id, mca.monthly_spending_analysis_id, mca.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, mca.spending_amount, mca.spending_ratio, mca.transaction_count, mca.weekly_average, mca.daily_average, mca.previous_month_change, mca.spending_rank, mca.mission_period_spending, mca.mission_transaction_count, mca.spending_share_score, mca.increase_score, mca.amount_rank_score, mca.recommendation_score, mca.recommendation_rank, mca.recommendation_eligible, mca.exclusion_reason, mca.recommendation_reason, mca.coaching_message, mca.created_at, mca.updated_at FROM monthly_category_analyses mca JOIN spending_categories sc ON mca.category_id = sc.id WHERE mca.monthly_spending_analysis_id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} ORDER BY mca.spending_rank ASC

SELECT mca.id, mca.monthly_spending_analysis_id, mca.category_id, sc.category_code, sc.category_name, mca.spending_amount, mca.spending_ratio, mca.transaction_count, mca.weekly_average, mca.daily_average, mca.previous_month_change, mca.spending_rank, mca.mission_period_spending, mca.mission_transaction_count, mca.spending_share_score, mca.increase_score, mca.amount_rank_score, mca.recommendation_score, mca.recommendation_rank, mca.recommendation_eligible, mca.exclusion_reason, mca.recommendation_reason, mca.coaching_message, mca.created_at, mca.updated_at FROM monthly_category_analyses mca JOIN spending_categories sc ON mca.category_id = sc.id WHERE mca.monthly_spending_analysis_id = #{monthlySpendingAnalysisId} AND mca.recommendation_rank IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mca.recommendation_rank ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE monthly_spending_analyses SET report_status = 'VIEWED', report_viewed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_year_month = #{analysisYearMonth} AND report_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE monthly_spending_analyses SET report_status = 'CLOSED', report_closed_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND analysis_year_month = #{analysisYearMonth} AND report_status IN ('PENDING', 'VIEWED')
